selection_status: Candidates, pending user screening; not mastery evidence
method: Read all 697 cues in three consecutive batches; review outer expression frames and inner chunks; exact quotation retrieval afterward.

items.meaning: 见到就让人高兴的人／事物（欢迎久别之人）
items.quote: All right. You're a sight for sore eyes.

items.meaning: 大老远赶来／特地跑这么远
items.quote: Sorry you had to come all this way.

items.chunk: be in a bit of a pickle
items.meaning: 遇上麻烦，陷入困境（口语，略带轻描淡写）
items.quote: Anyway. As you can see, I'm in a... A bit of a pickle.

items.meaning: 施展你的本事，把事情搞定（可恭维或请求帮助）
items.quote: Let's talk strategy, okay? 'Cause I need you to work your magic and make this whole situation go poof.

items.meaning: 行动方案／应对策略，不一定指军事攻击
items.quote: You got a plan of attack? Huh? Come on.

items.chunk: I know I haven't made it easy for you, but…
items.meaning: 我知道我让你为难／不好办了，但……（承认负担再请求）
items.quote: I know I haven't made it easy for you, but you are... you are the man!

items.meaning: 一套拿手办法／各种招数（可褒可贬）
items.quote: Right? I know you got a million legal loopholes that we can dance through... Big bag of tricks, you know?

items.chunk: be in it up to your neck
items.meaning: 深陷某个麻烦／脱不开身；it 回指当前困境
items.quote: Now that you're in it up to your neck, you can't even call me yourself... you have mom call me?

items.chunk: take it upon yourself to do sth.
items.meaning: 自行决定／主动承担做某事（也可批评擅自行动）
items.quote: Mom took it upon herself to call you!

items.chunk: hear what sb. wants to hear
items.meaning: 只听进自己想听的话，选择性理解
items.quote: She hears what she wants to hear, okay?

items.chunk: It's about time (that) sb. did sth.
items.meaning: 早该……了／是时候……了（did 不表示这件事已发生）
items.quote: And it's about time that I started to make both of us proud.

items.meaning: 只要……／前提是……（此处引出帮助的条件）
items.quote: So long as you understand that.

items.chunk: make a fool out of sb.
items.meaning: 让某人出丑／显得像傻瓜
items.quote: Jimmy, if I do this... If... Do not make a fool out of me.

items.chunk: Whatever it is, I'll do it.
items.meaning: 不管是什么，我都愿意做（无条件承诺）
items.quote: Just tell me what to do. Whatever it is, I'll do it.

items.chunk: You think that's the only reason I would…?
items.meaning: 你觉得那就是我会……的唯一原因吗？（反问、否认狭窄动机）
items.quote: Wait, you think that's the only reason I would call you at this time of night?

items.chunk: give sb. a little bit of credit
items.meaning: 别把某人想得那么差／承认其好的一面，不是给贷款
items.quote: I mean, can you just give me... Give me a little bit of credit, okay?

items.meaning: 最差也不过……／顶多……（给出最坏程度）
items.quote: I am calling you tonight with quality PG phone conversation... PG-13 at worst.

items.meaning: 工作多得忙不过来
items.quote: Uh, you're, uh, probably swamped with work anyways,

items.meaning: 机会等主动送到面前，不费力便得到
items.quote: Uh, you're, uh, probably swamped with work anyways, what, with that big, fat, giant case falling right into your lap.

items.chunk: steal sth. right out from under sb.
items.meaning: 就在某人眼皮底下把东西／机会抢走
items.quote: The primo client your dipwad boss stole right out from under me.

items.meaning: 卷走／偷走多少钱；不是 get away with doing sth. 的逃脱惩罚义
items.quote: Hey, um, how much exactly did Kettleman get away with?

items.meaning: 有权知道（强调知情权）
items.quote: Uh, excuse me, but I'm a taxpayer in this county. I think I have a right to know.

items.chunk: It's not like I'm… or anything.
items.meaning: 我又不是……之类的（弱化或否认某种身份／关系）
items.quote: And besides, it's not like I'm his lawyer or anything.

items.meaning: 把未定的想法随口说出来，不是已经作出决定
items.quote: I'm... I'm drunk. So, I'm just, uh... I'm thinking out loud. I'm... I'm up, spinning, uh... Spinning thoughts.

items.chunk: Would you work with me here?
items.meaning: 你能配合我一下／跟我一起找个办法吗？（争取协商）
items.quote: Would you work with me here?

items.meaning: 无法离开、只能听下去的听众（此处带玩笑）
items.quote: Well, you're kind of a captive audience.

items.meaning: 先听某人把话说完，再作判断
items.quote: But hear me out. Wow.

items.meaning: 分清这个和另一个；原句指连不同被告都分不清
items.quote: and you can't tell one defendant from another?!

items.meaning: 你知道流程／规矩的（熟悉、重复的做法）
items.quote: You know the drill... Money or the validation.

items.chunk: I'm not making you do anything.
items.meaning: 我没有强迫你做什么（否认自己在施加要求）
items.quote: I'm not making you do anything. Those are the rules.

items.chunk: Whatever helps you sleep at night.
items.meaning: 你觉得这样就问心无愧，那随你吧（此处讽刺自我开脱）
items.quote: Hey, whatever helps you sleep at night.

items.meaning: 没有某人／某物的踪迹
items.quote: The place was ransacked. No sign of the family.

items.meaning: 在她需要帮助／处境困难的时候
items.quote: I'm just supporting a friend in her time of need.

items.meaning: 根据零碎迹象推测情况；原本指以茶叶占卜
items.quote: I'm just reading tea leaves, same way I knew the Kettlemans needed a lawyer.

items.chunk: You would… if you could…, right?
items.meaning: 如果你能……，你会……的，对吧？（求证、施加期待）
items.quote: You would... Say something if you could help find them, right?

items.meaning: 越……就越……；此处强调逗留造成额外解释负担
items.quote: The longer you stay here, the more explaining I have to do to Hamlin.

items.chunk: You'll tell me if there's anything I can do?
items.meaning: 有我能帮忙的地方，你会告诉我吧？（试探性提供帮助）
items.quote: Hey, you'll tell me if there's anything I can do?

items.meaning: 事情会有办法／会顺利解决（安慰，不是锻炼）
items.quote: Everything is gonna be fine. It's gonna work out. A okay. It's gonna be fine.

items.meaning: 请在你方便时尽快……（较正式，不是随时都行）
items.quote: Um, so call me at 146-8729 at your earliest convenience. But soon, please.

items.meaning: 澄清一下……（纠正可能的误会）
items.quote: Uh... Just to clarify, look, I don't know anything. Uh, I have spoken to no one, and, uh, there are no rats on this ship.

items.chunk: for the sake of everyone involved
items.meaning: 为了所有相关的人着想
items.quote: But for the sake of everyone involved, I would just like to open a dialogue.

items.meaning: 开始沟通，建立协商渠道（较正式）
items.quote: But for the sake of everyone involved, I would just like to open a dialogue.

items.meaning: 时间至关重要，不能拖延（正式、强调紧迫）
items.quote: If I didn't say it before, time is of the essence on this matter, so, uh, I'm gonna hang up now... If you're trying to call.

items.meaning: 处理眼前危机／平息问题（比喻）
items.quote: I can put out this fire, if there is a fire.

items.meaning: 对某人说一大通；常指训斥／抱怨，此处指告知大量不利信息
items.quote: Uh, those two detectives... They just gave me an earful. And what they were telling me is... it's problematic.

items.meaning: 对情况／目标有一致理解
items.quote: I'm gonna pitch it back to you so I know we're on the same page.

items.meaning: 把数额／程度降到……；此处是争取降低刑期
items.quote: I feel very good about knocking your sentence down to the minimum... 18 years.

items.meaning: 参与讨论，发表意见
items.quote: Y... you want to tell me your thoughts and weigh in?

items.chunk: a plan sb. can get behind
items.meaning: 某人愿意支持的计划；get behind 指支持
items.quote: Does this sound like a plan that you can get behind?

items.meaning: 陷害某人／让某人背锅；此处不是帮忙安排约会或设备
items.quote: - You set me up. - I what? You gave my score to another crew, and now you're setting me up.

items.meaning: 你是说……？（核实含义或表达怀疑）
items.quote: Are you saying that you had nothing to do with this?

items.chunk: have nothing to do with sth.
items.meaning: 与某事毫无关系；此处否认参与，不是没有事可做
items.quote: Are you saying that you had nothing to do with this?

items.meaning: 你说这怎么回事／真是让人想不通（此处带讽刺）
items.quote: Now here I am, under arrest. Go figure.

items.meaning: 你说的“糟”具体是指……？（as in 用来要求澄清含义）
items.quote: it's gonna be bad for you... really bad. Bad? Bad as in...

items.meaning: 得了吧／少来这套（此处表示不相信，不是请求休息）
items.quote: He... he doesn't know because he didn't do it. Ah, Christ. Give me a break.

items.meaning: 你为什么这么肯定？（追问判断依据）
items.quote: How are you so sure?

items.meaning: 可真方便啊／借口可真巧啊（此处讽刺）
items.quote: That'll take weeks, if we could even get a DNA sample to compare it to. Well, isn't that convenient?

items.meaning: 指向某人／某种解释的证据
items.quote: Look, there are no other suspects. There's no evidence that points to anyone else.

items.meaning: 目的达到了／任务完成；此处讽刺对方已使自己动摇
items.quote: All right, you wanted me to crack? Mission accomplished.

items.meaning: 你想怎么做都行；此处将许可限制在找回家人之后
items.quote: Advocate for the guy all you want after we get these people back safe. In the meantime, help us.

items.meaning: 完全说得通／很合乎道理
items.quote: - I... it makes perfect sense. - How does it make sense?

items.meaning: 误导某人，使其判断偏离正轨
items.quote: They staged this to throw everyone off.

items.meaning: 把消息传出去／通知大家
items.quote: You... you got to put the word out.

items.meaning: 你不觉得……有可能吗？（挑战对方的排除判断）
items.quote: You don't think it's possible I'm right?

items.meaning: 私下、秘密地（口语表达，不当作正式通知用语）
items.quote: I've got to tell you something on the Q.T., and promise not to be upset with me.

items.chunk: No way am I doing sth.
items.meaning: 我绝不……（强烈拒绝；No way 前置后倒装）
items.quote: No way am I making that promise.

items.meaning: 把那件事归为……（借档案分类来评价，常带幽默）
items.quote: I did, with the tube and the whole thing, which probably scared the living shit out of them, and they took off, which, you know, file that under "unintended consequences,"

items.meaning: 或者，更好的办法是……（升级前一个建议）
items.quote: Now we have to find them. I mean... or, better yet, get the cops to let Varga go because right now my ass is on a highway to the danger zone.

items.meaning: 我绝不／不可能……（坚决排除某个行动）
items.quote: No, there's n... there's no way I'm gonna rat on this guy. I will never be safe.

items.meaning: 告发／出卖某人（负面评价）
items.quote: No, there's n... there's no way I'm gonna rat on this guy. I will never be safe.

items.meaning: 在逃／躲避追捕
items.quote: No, I have to convince the cops that I'm right, get them to stop looking at Nacho, and catch the Kettlemans on the run.

items.chunk: be not exactly + 名词／形容词
items.meaning: 算不上……／也不是多么……（此处委婉说他们不聪明）
items.quote: Well, you've met these people, right? They're... they're not exactly masterminds, right?

items.meaning: 参与某件正在进行的事
items.quote: The FBI, too... I heard they're getting in on this.

items.meaning: 对某些人有影响力，能说得上话
items.quote: He has clout with these people.

items.meaning: 由某人拍板／这是某人的决定
items.quote: It's Hamlin's call, and Hamlin will never agree.

items.chunk: Even if it were up to me,…
items.meaning: 即使由我决定，……（假设让步；此处仍表示不能答应）
items.quote: And even if it were up to me, you know I couldn't.

items.meaning: 让某人听进道理、理智一些
items.quote: I'm gonna go talk to Nacho. I'll try to make him see reason.

items.chunk: I don't think you want to be doing that.
items.meaning: 我觉得你最好别那么做（此处是含蓄警告）
items.quote: Hey. I'm gonna... I'm gonna park right here. I don't think you want to be doing that.

items.meaning: 掌握足以证明某人有错／犯罪的证据（美式；原对白的主张）
items.quote: Yeah, county treasurer embezzled funds. I read the paper. Yeah, well, we got this gangbanger dead to rights.

items.meaning: 愿意参与／支持某个方案
items.quote: So, what do you say? You on board? Help us do some good.

items.meaning: 不再追究／放过某件事；此处是不追究冲突
items.quote: Now, this gentleman is willing to let this go, not press charges, if you help us out.

items.meaning: 提出刑事控告／要求追究刑事责任（法律用语，不等于个人决定检方一定起诉）
items.quote: Now, this gentleman is willing to let this go, not press charges, if you help us out.

items.meaning: 像坏唱片一样反复说同样的话（原文用 definition of a broken record）
items.quote: Wait, guys, I'm the definition of a broken record on this one. Nacho is "not-cho" man, comprendo?

items.meaning: 你尽管使出最狠的手段吧（强硬挑衅）
items.quote: You're gonna keep playing that line, it's gonna go rough. You know what? Do your worst.

items.chunk: I thought you had our backs.
items.meaning: 我还以为你会支持／保护我们（失望或责怪）
items.quote: What are you doing, buddy? I thought you had our backs.

items.meaning: 多放点某种东西；此处要水果礼篮多放菠萝
items.quote: When you realize how wrong you are about all this, I'll take an edible arrangement as a "sorry." Heavy on the pineapple.

items.meaning: 放过某人，使其免于责任／困境
items.quote: How come you let me off the hook back there?

items.meaning: 见好就收，不要继续冒险把优势弄丢
items.quote: Why don't you quit while you're ahead and go on your way?

items.meaning: 我不愿／不能接受……这种解释（明确否认）
items.quote: No, I refuse to believe it's because you have something resembling a heart inside your body.

items.meaning: 暂时站在相反立场提出质疑，不一定真持反对意见；原文省略 play
items.quote: Devil's advocate... like the cops said, uh, the Kettlemans' cars are still at their house. There's no record of them leaving.

items.meaning: 很可能……／大概率……
items.quote: Odds are, they didn't get out of their neighborhood.

items.meaning: 你说什么？／再说一遍？（没听清或惊讶）
items.quote: What? What? They... come again?

items.meaning: 偷偷离开城镇／跑路，常为逃避麻烦
items.quote: This bookie disappeared after the super bowl... Cowboys/steelers... took $6 million in bets and skipped town when things didn't go his way.

items.meaning: 事情没有按他希望的方向发展
items.quote: This bookie disappeared after the super bowl... Cowboys/steelers... took $6 million in bets and skipped town when things didn't go his way.

items.chunk: It's human nature to want to…
items.meaning: 想要……是人之常情（用于解释动机）
items.quote: Now, that's what everybody expects. It's human nature to want to stay close to home,

items.chunk: I don't know about you, but…
items.meaning: 不知道你怎么想，但我……（引出自己的偏好／立场）
items.quote: Oh, hey, I don't know about you, but I would love a little "John Jacob Jingleheimer Schmidt."

items.meaning: 把事情详细谈清楚／讨论到有结果；不是仅随便聊聊
items.quote: Uh, look, could... please, could we just - talk this through, okay? - It's not an option.

items.meaning: 这不是可以选择的办法／这事没得商量（此处拒绝继续谈）
items.quote: Uh, look, could... please, could we just - talk this through, okay? - It's not an option.

lexical_checks.note: Dictionary core sense is angry complaint; contextual extended interpretation labelled in gloss.
with no chance of escape or excuse; dictionary includes have him dead to rights for robbery.
Cambridge English Corpus gives figurative use about political change; not frequency proof.
